title: Design: Edit Customer and the card with only Default
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Customers — View', 'Customers — Create & Edit' and 'View and Manage AP/AR Data'.
  • Use a client whose Tiers list shows only Default.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, in that client.
  • Use a desktop browser window exactly 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so the screen matches the design pictures' size.
custom_steps:
1. Open customer A's page from Customers.
  2. Click the edit pencil on the customer card.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The card's PRICING section shows Labor Rate, Shop Supplies and Tax, with no tier rows.

Step 2:

  • Edit Customer goes from Default Shop Supplies straight to Notes, with no tier fields.
  • The dialog matches picture 9.37.
